text_sanskrit: कथं न ज्ञेयमस्माभिः पापादस्मान्निवर्तितुम् । कुलक्षयकृतं दोषं प्रपश्यद्भिर्जनार्दन ॥ १-३९ ॥
itrans: katha.n na j~neyamasmAbhiH pApAdasmAnnivartitum . kulakShayakR^ita.n doShaM prapashyadbhirjanArdana .. 1-39 ..
translation: Only sin will take hold of us in slaying these, for though they are ruffians, we kill our own kinsmen. So, it is not fit that we kill the sons of Dhritarashtra, our kinsmen. Indeed, how can we be happy, O Madhava, having killed our kith and kin? However, those infatuated with greed do not see the guilt) in the destruction of the race and do not see the sin in being treacherous (to the lives of) friends. Why should not we also) see that it is wise) to turn away from such a sin, O Janardana, we who clearly perceive the evils in the destruction of races?
